modelLimitations.title: Research model limitations
items: Research and education only — not a medical device, and not for diagnosis, treatment, or patient-specific decisions.
A 0D lumped-parameter model cannot resolve spatial blood flow, local wall stress, or three-dimensional hemodynamics.
The current exact V3 package is an experimental development default. It does not claim release readiness, simulation readiness, or clinical validation.
Parameters and outputs are approximations and require validation for each intended scientific use.
The end-systolic radial and Klotz-informed diastolic curves on a PV loop are orientation references, not formal ESPVR or EDPVR estimates.
